settings.DNS_RESOLVER.label: Instance DNS
settings.DNS_RESOLVER.description: Resolver for this instance only. HTTPS presets leave device DNS and VPN unchanged. Upstream proxies resolve on their host. Restart to apply.
settings.DNS_SERVERS.label: Custom DNS servers
settings.DNS_SERVERS.description: Custom mode: up to four IP addresses (optional port; bracket IPv6 ports) or HTTPS DNS-over-HTTPS URLs, separated by commas. IP servers use unencrypted DNS over TCP. Custom HTTPS hostnames use system DNS only to locate the resolver. No system fallback for destination queries.
settings.TELEMETRY_ENABLED.label: Telemetry enabled
settings.TELEMETRY_ENABLED.description: Voluntarily share target domain, known challenge type, outcome, duration and TRAWL version with the configured collector. No payloads, paths, query parameters, cookies, keys, raw logs or persistent client identifiers are sent. The receiver necessarily sees the network connection IP. Requires TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT; disabled by default.
settings.TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT.label: Telemetry endpoint
settings.TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT.description: HTTPS usage collector URL, including /v1/events. No collector is configured or contacted by default.
settings.PORT.label: API port
settings.PORT.description: Port used by the native HTTP API. Change this if another service already uses the port.
settings.SCRAPE_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS.label: Request timeout
settings.SCRAPE_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS.descripti: Default scrape deadline in milliseconds; per-request maxTimeout takes precedence.
settings.FLARESOLVERR_COOKIE_FALLBACK.de: Optional /v1 GET browser fallback when an HTTP success returns no usable cookies.
settings.WAF_DETECTION_ENABLED.label: Detect WAF providers
settings.WAF_DETECTION_ENABLED.descripti: Offline WAF provider diagnostics. False disables the worker for every API entry point.
settings.MCP_ENABLED.label: Enable MCP tools
settings.MCP_ENABLED.description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) scraping tool. Keep disabled on public networks.
settings.MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.label: Allowed browser origins
settings.MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call /mcp. Requests without Origin (normal server-to-server clients) are accepted.
settings.METRICS_DASHBOARD_ENABLED.label: Enable dashboard metrics
settings.METRICS_DASHBOARD_ENABLED.descr: Optional dashboard. Set ENABLED=true only when its port is bound to 127.0.0.1. A token of at least 32 characters protects data if the port is reachable elsewhere.
settings.METRICS_DASHBOARD_TOKEN.label: Dashboard access token
settings.METRICS_DASHBOARD_TOKEN.descrip: Bearer token protecting dashboard data. Use at least 32 characters when configured. The desktop generates a local token when needed.
settings.OBSERVABILITY_ENABLED.label: Observability enabled
settings.OBSERVABILITY_ENABLED.descripti: Read-only settings, request history and separate request/log streams. Requires METRICS_DASHBOARD_TOKEN; anonymous dashboard access does not enable these resources.
settings.HISTORY_CAPTURE_REQUESTS.label: History capture requests
settings.HISTORY_CAPTURE_REQUESTS.descri: Save request parameters for all sources, including URL, target headers, cookies, proxy credentials and payload. Requires authenticated observability. Uses the same artifact, retention and storage limits as saved responses; disabled by default.
settings.HISTORY_CAPTURE_MODE.label: History capture mode
settings.HISTORY_CAPTURE_MODE.descriptio: Saved response content. Metadata-only by default; html, screenshot or both require authenticated observability. Request payload capture is configured separately.
settings.BROWSER_INSPECTION_ENABLED.desc: Authenticated inspection of existing browser pages and optional live previews. Requires observability; never opens or navigates a page by itself.
settings.HISTORY_CAPTURE_MAX_BYTES.label: History capture max bytes
settings.HISTORY_CAPTURE_MAX_BYTES.descr: Maximum uncompressed bytes for each saved artifact.
settings.HISTORY_CAPTURE_STORAGE_BYTES.d: Maximum captured-content bytes on disk. The bounded SQLite index is separate.
settings.HISTORY_CAPTURE_MAX_RECORDS.des: Maximum request records with saved content. Old files are evicted first.
settings.HISTORY_CAPTURE_TTL_SECONDS.des: Saved-content retention in seconds. Lightweight history can outlive its artifacts.
settings.HISTORY_CAPTURE_FALLBACK_HTML.d: Save available HTML when screenshot-only capture cannot obtain a usable image.
settings.HISTORY_CAPTURE_TIMEOUT_MS.desc: Best-effort screenshot deadline within the scrape budget; skips capture when insufficient time remains.
settings.HISTORY_CAPTURE_SCREENSHOT_WIDT: Maximum saved screenshot width without resizing the browser viewport.
settings.HISTORY_CAPTURE_SCREENSHOT_HEIG: Maximum saved screenshot height. Captures the current viewport, not a new navigation.
settings.HISTORY_CAPTURE_SCREENSHOT_QUAL: JPEG quality for additional history screenshots; a bounded existing viewport screenshot may be reused.
settings.METRICS_DB_PATH.label: History database path
settings.METRICS_DB_PATH.description: SQLite file used to retain request history. Managed native instances use their private data directory unless you override this path.
settings.BROWSER_POOL_SIZE.label: Browser pool size
settings.BROWSER_POOL_SIZE.description: Number of warm browser instances available to solve challenges. More instances increase parallel capacity and memory usage.
settings.BROWSER_GEOIP_IP.label: Public egress IP
settings.BROWSER_GEOIP_IP.description: Optional actual public egress IP; skips external IP discovery while retaining GeoIP.
settings.BROWSER_SESSION_MAX_ENTRIES.des: Maximum named browser contexts per browser. A smaller value reduces retained session memory.
settings.BROWSER_SESSION_TTL_SECONDS.des: Idle lifetime of a named browser session, in seconds. Expired sessions are closed to release resources.
settings.LOG_LEVEL.label: Log verbosity
settings.LOG_LEVEL.description: Minimum log level to record. Debug includes additional operational details; info is the normal setting.
settings.BROWSER_ACQUIRE_TIMEOUT_MS.desc: Time to wait for a free browser before rejecting a request.
Recycle a browser after this many temporary challenge contexts. Set 0 to disable count-based recycling; memory-pressure recovery remains.
settings.BROWSER_MAX_CONTENT_PROCESSES.d: Maximum Firefox content processes per browser.
settings.BROWSER_BLOCK_ADS.label: Block ads and trackers
settings.BROWSER_BLOCK_ADS.description: Set false to omit uBlock Origin and reduce extension overhead; ads/trackers will load.
settings.BROWSER_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS.label: Close idle browsers after
settings.BROWSER_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS.descrip: Optional idle retirement; 0 keeps browsers warm. Wake adds a cold start.
settings.BROWSER_COLD_BOOT.label: Start browsers on demand
settings.BROWSER_COLD_BOOT.description: Skip browser launches at startup; the first browser-backed request starts them.
settings.BROWSER_HEADFUL_POOL_SIZE.label: Extra headful browsers
settings.BROWSER_HEADFUL_POOL_SIZE.descr: Extra visible-browser instances used for targets that require headful mode, such as supported DataDome flows. These are additional to the regular pool and use more memory.
settings.SCRAPE_MIN_TIER.label: Minimum execution tier
settings.SCRAPE_MIN_TIER.description: Lowest scraper tier allowed for every endpoint (1=HTTP, 2=cached browser, 3=fresh browser, 4=residential proxy). Values above 1 increase browser load.
settings.TIER1_TRANSPORT.label: HTTP transport
settings.TIER1_TRANSPORT.description: Optional Firefox TLS/HTTP2 impersonation in Tier 1: bun (default) or wreq.
settings.USER_PREFS.label: Advanced Firefox preferences
settings.USER_PREFS.description: Optional Firefox prefs applied to every launched browser, as a JSON object.
settings.BROWSER_STALL_TIMEOUT_MS.label: Browser stall timeout MS
settings.BROWSER_STALL_TIMEOUT_MS.descri: Grace period after a request timeout before a checked-out browser is reclaimed.
settings.BROWSER_CLOSE_TIMEOUT_MS.label: Browser close timeout MS
settings.BROWSER_CLOSE_TIMEOUT_MS.descri: Maximum time to wait while closing a wedged browser or context.
settings.BROWSER_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_MS.label: Request drain on shutdown
settings.BROWSER_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_MS.descr: Maximum time shutdown waits for accepted API requests. 0 closes them at once.
settings.BROWSER_LAUNCH_TIMEOUT_MS.label: Browser launch timeout MS
settings.BROWSER_LAUNCH_TIMEOUT_MS.descr: Maximum time to wait for a browser launch.
settings.SCREENSHOT_SETTLE_MS.label: Screenshot settle MS
settings.SCREENSHOT_SETTLE_MS.descriptio: Extra settling time before an explicitly requested browser screenshot, in milliseconds.
settings.SCREENSHOT_TIMEOUT_MS.label: Screenshot timeout MS
settings.SCREENSHOT_TIMEOUT_MS.descripti: Maximum time allowed to capture a requested screenshot, in milliseconds.
settings.SCREENSHOT_JPEG_QUALITY.label: Screenshot JPEG quality
settings.SCREENSHOT_JPEG_QUALITY.descrip: JPEG quality from 1 to 100. Higher values increase image size.
settings.SCREENSHOT_MAX_BYTES.label: Screenshot max bytes
settings.SCREENSHOT_MAX_BYTES.descriptio: Maximum encoded screenshot size. Larger screenshots are omitted from the response.
settings.BLOCKED_EVIDENCE_MAX_HTML_CHARS: Maximum challenge-page HTML returned when blocked-page evidence is explicitly requested on a failed scrape.
settings.DIAGNOSTICS_MAX_CONSOLE_ENTRIES: Maximum console entries retained when browser diagnostics are requested.
settings.DIAGNOSTICS_MAX_NETWORK_ENTRIES: Maximum network entries retained when browser diagnostics are requested.
settings.DIAGNOSTICS_MAX_STRING_CHARS.de: Character limit for a single diagnostic message or URL.
settings.DIAGNOSTICS_MAX_TOTAL_CHARS.des: Combined character budget for diagnostic strings in one response.
settings.DIAGNOSTICS_SIZE_TIMEOUT_MS.des: Maximum time spent checking browser resource sizes for diagnostics, in milliseconds.
settings.REDIRECT_MAX_ENTRIES.label: Redirect max entries
settings.REDIRECT_MAX_ENTRIES.descriptio: Maximum main-document redirects returned when redirect history is requested.
settings.REDIRECT_MAX_URL_CHARS.label: Redirect max URL chars
settings.REDIRECT_MAX_URL_CHARS.descript: Character limit for one URL in a returned redirect chain.
settings.REDIRECT_MAX_TOTAL_CHARS.label: Redirect max total chars
settings.REDIRECT_MAX_TOTAL_CHARS.descri: Combined character budget for all URLs in a returned redirect chain.
settings.CAPTURE_MAX_PATTERNS.label: Capture max patterns
settings.CAPTURE_MAX_PATTERNS.descriptio: Maximum URL patterns accepted when response-body capture is requested.
settings.CAPTURE_MAX_RESPONSES.label: Capture max responses
settings.CAPTURE_MAX_RESPONSES.descripti: Maximum matching responses retained by one capture request.
settings.CAPTURE_MAX_BODY_BYTES.label: Capture max body bytes
settings.CAPTURE_MAX_BODY_BYTES.descript: Maximum retained body size for one captured response. Larger bodies are truncated.
settings.CAPTURE_MAX_TOTAL_BYTES.label: Capture max total bytes
settings.CAPTURE_MAX_TOTAL_BYTES.descrip: Combined retained body budget for all captured responses.
settings.CAPTURE_MAX_READ_BYTES.label: Capture max read bytes
settings.CAPTURE_MAX_READ_BYTES.descript: Total budget for reading declared response bodies. Unknown-size and compressed bodies are skipped.
settings.CAPTURE_MAX_METADATA_CHARS.desc: Character limit for a captured metadata string, such as a response URL.
settings.CAPTURE_BODY_TIMEOUT_MS.label: Capture body timeout MS
settings.CAPTURE_BODY_TIMEOUT_MS.descrip: Maximum time to read one captured response body, in milliseconds.
settings.CAPTURE_SETTLE_MS.label: Capture settle MS
settings.CAPTURE_SETTLE_MS.description: Default settling budget for explicitly requested response capture.
settings.CAPTURE_MAX_SETTLE_MS.label: Capture max settle MS
settings.CAPTURE_MAX_SETTLE_MS.descripti: Upper bound for a request-specific response capture settling time.
settings.CAPTURE_IDLE_FLOOR_MS.label: Capture idle floor MS
settings.CAPTURE_IDLE_FLOOR_MS.descripti: Minimum settling time before network idle can finish a response capture.
settings.MHTML_MAX_PARTS.label: MHTML max parts
settings.MHTML_MAX_PARTS.description: Maximum resources included when a best-effort MHTML archive is requested.
settings.MHTML_MAX_PART_BYTES.label: MHTML max part bytes
settings.MHTML_MAX_PART_BYTES.descriptio: Maximum size of one resource included in a requested MHTML archive.
settings.MHTML_MAX_TOTAL_CHARS.label: MHTML max total chars

settings.MHTML_MAX_INFLIGHT_READS.label: MHTML max inflight reads
settings.MHTML_MAX_INFLIGHT_READS.descri: Maximum concurrent resource reads while building an MHTML archive.
settings.MHTML_MAX_OMISSION_RECORDS.desc: Maximum omitted-resource records returned with a partial MHTML archive.

settings.REDIS_SESSION_TTL_SECONDS.label: Clearance cache lifetime

settings.REDIS_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS.label: Redis connect timeout MS

settings.REDIS_RETRY_DELAY_MS.label: Redis retry delay MS

settings.SCRAPE_PROXY_SELECTION.label: Proxy selection strategy

settings.PROXY_LIST_FILE.label: Datacenter proxy list file

settings.RESIDENTIAL_PROXY_URL.label: Residential proxy URLs
settings.RESIDENTIAL_PROXY_URL.descripti: Residential proxy URLs for final-tier escalation. Supports HTTP and SOCKS5, including authentication; separate endpoints with commas.

settings.MITM_PORT.label: Proxy listen port

settings.MITM_CA_DIR.label: Proxy certificate directory

settings.MITM_MAX_TIER.label: Maximum escalation tier
settings.MITM_MAX_TIER.description: Highest allowed escalation tier. Leave empty to allow Tier 4.
settings.MITM_ALWAYS_SCRAPE.label: Always use the scraper
settings.MITM_ALWAYS_SCRAPE.description: Skip the direct Tier 0 probe and route requests through the scraper. Disables Tier 0 streaming.
settings.MITM_ESCALATE_429.label: Escalate HTTP 429 responses
settings.MITM_ESCALATE_429.description: Try the scraper for unrecognized HTTP 429 responses. Can repeat requests and use browsers.
settings.MITM_DEBUG.label: Log proxy requests
settings.MITM_DEBUG.description: Logs proxied requests. Errors are always logged.

settings.STT_API_KEY.label: Speech-to-text API key

settings.STT_MODEL.label: Speech-to-text model
settings.STT_MODEL.description: Optional model name sent to the speech-to-text endpoint (default whisper-1).
settings.FFMPEG_PATH.label: Custom FFmpeg path
settings.FFMPEG_PATH.description: Optional ffmpeg executable override used for audio conversion.

settings.CAPTCHA_SOLVER.description: Optional paid CAPTCHA fallback. A key alone does not enable it. Automatic: single declarative reCAPTCHA v2/Enterprise and standalone Turnstile. Other documented task types need hostname profiles with explicit verification.
settings.TWOCAPTCHA_API_KEY.label: 2Captcha API key
settings.TWOCAPTCHA_API_KEY.description: API key for the optional 2Captcha fallback. A key alone does not enable paid solving.
settings.CAPTCHA_SOLVER_MAX_TASKS.label: Captcha solver max tasks
settings.CAPTCHA_SOLVER_MAX_TASKS.descri: Shared limit across all tiers of one scrape (1-3). No automatic create retries.

settings.CAPTCHA_SOLVER_PROFILES.label: Hostname solver profiles
settings.CAPTCHA_SOLVER_PROFILES.descrip: Optional JSON array of hostname-bound task and delivery profiles. See docs.

tour.name: TRAWL · App tour
tour.navigation.title: Your workspace
tour.navigation.desktop: The sidebar groups requests and runtime tools. App settings, Server settings and your active instance stay at the bottom.
tour.navigation.phone: Overview and Requests are in the bottom bar. Tools contains the browser, resources and logs; Settings contains app and server preferences.
tour.navigation.detail: This tour visits real screens without sending requests or changing settings. You can close it at any time and reopen it in App settings.
tour.instance.title: Choose where requests run
tour.instance.description: Use this device or add an existing instance in App settings. Each instance has its own history, sessions and server configuration.
tour.instance.desktop: The instance selector switches the whole workspace. Remote servers run on their own host; connection credentials stay on this device.
tour.instance.android: Android runs a background server with the system WebView. A remote desktop or server instance provides the full browser engine.
tour.server.title: Start, stop and restart
tour.server.desktop: Start and Stop control the local server. The three-dot menu also offers Restart. Remote instances are managed on their own host.
tour.server.phone: The three-dot menu contains local server controls. Start before sending requests; restart after saving settings that require it.
tour.server.detail: On desktop, prepare the managed browser when Overview asks you to. App settings controls whether the server keeps running after you close the window.
tour.create.title: Keep requests in separate tabs
tour.create.description: The plus button opens New request. Up to eight draft tabs keep their own URL, headers, body and session options.
tour.create.detail: Switch tabs without replacing another draft. Drag them to reorder; closing a nonempty tab asks before discarding it.
tour.send.title: Build and send a request
tour.send.description: Choose a method and enter the target URL. Params, Headers, Auth, Body and Session configure the outgoing request.
tour.send.detail: Send runs against the active instance. The response shows content, headers and timing. Typing with no control focused starts entering the URL without sending it.
tour.history.title: Understand what happened
tour.history.description: Requests stores recorded history. Open a row for its result, measured execution stages and saved response content.
tour.history.detail: Timing explains the path and escalation when recorded. Initiator identifies the operation and session. Saved content is available only when capture was enabled.
tour.sessions.title: Reuse a session
tour.sessions.description: Sessions reuse cookies and browser state. Select a session in New request to continue the same visit.
tour.sessions.detail: Session activity lists script executions with their own time, result and optional source. It updates while visible; later scripts do not change completed request timings.
tour.settings.title: Configure the active server
tour.settings.description: Search finds settings across categories. Inherited values come from defaults or the host environment; custom values override them for this instance.
tour.settings.desktop: Standard and Economy preview resource changes. Custom means neither preset matches. Save your draft, then restart when requested. MCP is configured here too.
tour.settings.android: Android exposes supported API and network settings. DNS and proxies apply to this instance. Save your draft, then restart when requested.
tour.settings.remote: Remote settings are read-only here. Change them on the server’s host and restart when needed. Device preferences remain in App settings.
tour.preferences.title: Make the app yours
tour.preferences.description: App settings belongs to this device: language, shortcuts, window behavior, connections and updates.
tour.preferences.detail: System language falls back to English. On Android, disable Live activities for an ordinary collapsible notification. Reopen this tour from this section’s header.
tour.commands.title: Find a page or action
tour.commands.description: Search opens the command palette for pages, actions, instances and settings. Keycaps show shortcuts; customize them in App settings.
tour.commands.detail: Find on page searches current content. Back and Forward follow pages, tabs and dialogs; desktop trackpad gestures and mouse side buttons use the same navigation.
tour.refresh.title: Stay up to date
tour.refresh.desktop: Refresh page updates the current screen. Its shortcut works throughout the workspace; sections share this action.
tour.refresh.phone: At the top of a page, pull down until the indicator is complete, then release. It spins while the visible page refreshes.
tour.refresh.detail: Live data updates automatically while visible. Refresh requests a fresh snapshot. You can now explore; your drafts and settings have been preserved.
